items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 11 October 2026 6:09am
items.description:
##Today##

Dry & bright day with spells of sunshine, becoming cloudy later, then occasional rain & drizzle overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4 later


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

W or W-NW 10-15, soon backing Southerly 5-10, backing SE 15-20 this evening, increasing 20-25 tonight, veering Southerly 15-20 at end of the night.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain overnight with hill fog.


##Comments##

Strong winds later. Chance of slight coastal overtopping around high tide overnight.


##Tomorrow##
